Information about the bundled engine

Source: R/info.R
zuslothdb_info.Rd

Reports which SlothDB source the package was built from. The engine is vendored from pedrobtz/slothdb, zuslothdb's fork of upstream SlothDB: an upstream commit and the changes made on top of it, one commit each. A database file is tied to this commit.

Usage

zuslothdb_info()

Value

A list with elements engine ("SlothDB"), repository and commit (the fork and its full commit hash), tag (the fork's tag of that commit), upstream and upstream_commit (upstream SlothDB and the commit the fork is based on), describe (the last upstream release before it, as "v0.2.7+"), changes (a character vector of the fork's commit subjects since that commit, oldest first) and threads (the engine's thread cap, an integer).

Examples

info <- zuslothdb_info()
info$commit
#> [1] "6af32c5028ba5e1a94809d562d13b1649ffceeba"
info$changes
#>  [1] "Take the Windows branch under MinGW, not only MSVC"    
#>  [2] "Write nothing to stderr, never abort, use no rand()"   
#>  [3] "Refuse remote paths: offline only"                     
#>  [4] "Cap every thread pool with one process-wide limit"     
#>  [5] "Refuse STRFTIME with one argument"                     
#>  [6] "Fix two warnings R CMD check counts"                   
#>  [7] "Add a read-only database mode"                         
#>  [8] "Set stop flags under the mutex their waiters use"      
#>  [9] "Keep the Parquet decoder's scratch out of thread_local"
#> [10] "Size validity masks by their holder's capacity"        
#> [11] "Update seven doctests to DATE as days since 1970"      
#> [12] "Make ROLLBACK say that nothing was undone"
